foundation.note_en: Phan Vu's page "Ba Tri Wind Power Plant" (Ba Tri, Ben Tre) records D800 piles supplied to Huy Hoang Transportation & Logistics (HTL); V1-3 Ben Tre is in Ba Tri district and was the district's only completed farm then, but the page names neither V1-3 nor BTRE and is pile supply only, so PHC pile group with cap is just a lead.
